pick.name: Context7 (Upstash)
pick.why: Largest library index; official marketplace plugin
pick.free_limits: 1,000 API calls/month + 20 bonus/day after; Pro $10/seat/mo with 2,000 calls

alts.name: DeepWiki MCP (Cognition)
alts.what: Ask questions about any public GitHub repo
alts.why: Free, no auth; great for understanding an OSS dependency
alts.free_limits: free, no auth for public repos
alts.install: claude mcp add --transport http deepwiki https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp

candidates.name: WebFetch + llms.txt
candidates.verdict: fallback once Context7 quota is hit

decision: Context7's 1,000 calls a month covers a solo dev and stops API hallucinations on fast-moving libraries. When the quota runs out, fall back to WebFetch on llms.txt rather than paying.

verify.note: Plans page confirms: 1,000 API calls/month, then 20 bonus calls/day when blocked; private repos Pro/Enterprise only; Pro $10/seat/mo with 2,000 calls/seat then $5 per 1,000 (never blocked).
